_comment: The 6.9-inch App Store set, in upload order. Rendered by tools/screenshots/compose.py
src names are the raw captures (StoreShots.swift attachment names); the five
numbered ones are the names the integrator staged the first set under - compose.py
resolves either spelling, and the bridge's suffixed exports (s09-venue-home_0_<id>.png).
Headlines: benefit first, plain English, <= 32 characters, no hype, no emoji, and
nothing a fair-housing reviewer could read as a claim about people or neighbourhoods.
03 uses the column layout (the top of each Home, hero card readable); 05 starts at the leads banner (crop_top) - a mid-scroll capture's nav bar over half-scrolled tiles is not a store image.
08 needs s05-reel-studio (StoreShots opens the Reel Studio once the studio has seeded photos — TEST_RUNNER_STORESHOT_PHOTOS); it is skipped when the capture is missing.

frames.headline: Walk it once. A cinematic tour.
frames.subline: Film a walkthrough on your phone. It becomes a scroll-to-fly tour on its own page.

frames.headline: Every tool in one place
frames.subline: Tour, photos, reel, floor plan and aerial intro, all saved to one home.

frames.headline: Venues, gyms and restaurants too
frames.subline: Pick your business type. Home, the samples and every tour switch to match.

frames.headline: Photos fixed in one tap
frames.subline: Twilight, blue sky, tidy room, furniture. Every AI edit is labeled on the tour.

frames.headline: One link. Leads land in the app.
frames.subline: Every tour is one link with a lead form built in. Replies land here, with a tap to call or email.

frames.headline: Tap a room. Fly straight there.
frames.subline: Room tags become chapters on every tour. Buyers jump to the kitchen, the yard, the primary suite.

frames.headline: Your card on every tour
frames.subline: Buyers book a showing right from the tour. The lead comes straight to you.

frames.headline: Photos become a social reel
frames.subline: Pick the photos, add your voice and captions. One vertical video, ready to post.

frames.headline: Add the home. Film it. Share it.
frames.subline: Walk it at a normal pace or upload a clip. No film crew, no editing.
